AVOKADO MINI R5 / PROTOTYPE PLAN

From design
to a measurable prototype.

The R5 baseline targets a deployed height of 200 mm or less, one self-contained unit, and expansion with the same mini. Crowdfunding, supporter payments, and advance reservations have not opened.

01 / FIRST MILESTONE

First, measure whether one unit works.

  1. Measure the display method, optical safety, and visibility in an ordinary room.
  2. Measure precision 3D input, latency, tracking range, and false-input rate.
  3. Verify that compute, power, thermal, voice, and communications systems can fit safely within 200 mm.

02 / OPEN CONDITIONS

Price and funding terms are not set.

The old E3 configuration of four towers plus a separate hub, and its pricing, do not apply to R5. Terms will be published only after the method, components, prototype costs, legal requirements, and timeline are reviewed.

Funding has not started
